title: M5 stage44: semantic prefix partition for actual recovery
scope: Shared finite semantic partition lemma; actual arithmetic oracle identification remains mandatory.

spec.name: M5.PrefixPartition.prefix_next
spec.statement: ∀ (α : Type) (p q : List α) (a : α) (h : p.length < q.length), (p ++ [a]).IsPrefix q ↔ p.IsPrefix q ∧ q.get ⟨p.length, h⟩ = a
spec.guidance: Forward shorten the prefix and compare getElem at p.length. Reverse use List.concat_get_prefix (h : p <+: q) (hl : p.length < q.length). List.IsPrefix.getElem identifies entries. All symbols are core List definitions. Return tactic lines only, without leading by, preserve target.

spec.name: M5.PrefixPartition.count_empty
spec.statement: ∀ (α : Type) (W : Finset (List α)), M5.PrefixPartition.count W [] = (W.card : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Unfold count; every list has empty prefix. Return tactic lines only, without leading by, preserve target.

spec.name: M5.PrefixPartition.count_partition
spec.statement: ∀ (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (W : Finset (List α)) (m : ℕ) (p : List α), (∀ q ∈ W, q.length = m) → p.length < m → M5.PrefixPartition.count W p = ∑ a : α, M5.PrefixPartition.count W (p ++ [a])
spec.guidance: Partition W.filter(prefix p) by its next entry. Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise gives #s = sum b in t, #(s.filter (f · = b)); t=univ. Use a total next-entry function defined with if h:p.length<q.length then q.get... else an arbitrary fallback; choose fallback from a word if needed, or split nonempty alpha / empty W. Alternatively commute finite sums of 0/1 indicators and use uniqueness of next letter from prefix_next. Preserve finite semantic helper only, no claim this defines arithmetic C/A. Return tactic lines only, without leading by, preserve target.

spec.name: M5.PrefixPartition.count_terminal
spec.statement: ∀ (α : Type) [DecidableEq α] (W : Finset (List α)) (m : ℕ) (p : List α), (∀ q ∈ W, q.length = m) → p.length = m → M5.PrefixPartition.count W p = (if p ∈ W then 1 else 0)
spec.guidance: At equal length List.IsPrefix.eq_of_length shows prefix iff equality. Rewrite filtered W to singleton p or empty. No assumption that W is nonempty. Return tactic lines only, without leading by, preserve target.
